followUps.title: Compound insight — the dozer shortage behind the ramp-fill pause
followUps.body: The July 4 meeting note said the Northwest Ramp Fill was paused for a dozer-resource constraint. The July 4 Daily Availability Final Report shows the physical shortage: the site's single wheel dozer (WD-145) was at 39.58% on a planned valve-lash, and track dozer DZ-248 was down 23 hrs on a hydraulic oil leak — no spare push capacity. Also caught: EX-340 down 12 hrs (arm stick), EX-262 8.5 hrs (hydraulic low power), EX-123 "Bucket Lip Shroud Missing" (a GET-loss signal), and a fleet-wide "tyre damage" pattern across the 775/777 dump trucks that puts unit-level detail behind the June 28 Tire Damages reference. DR-125's "12 hrs s/by (lack of operator)" reading confirms the down-vs-idle contradiction resolves to "available."

followUps.title: Survey
followUps.body: Day 10 (260705) +13.5%, a second straight positive day; MTD survey +8.77% over tally. Forecast: Week 28 & 29 excavator plan ~307,135 BCM; EX-104 stays fully offline; drill capacity thinnest mid-to-late W29 (DR-342 and DR-139 multi-day services).
